interactive.label: Save
interactive.tooltip: Write the plugin settings. Menu changes take effect after a restart.

interactive.label: Revert
interactive.tooltip: Discard every change made since the last save (asks first).

interactive.label: Rescan
interactive.tooltip: Walk the plugin folders again and rebuild the list, in the background.

interactive.label: Install…
interactive.tooltip: Install a plugin from a .zip archive (or, if you cancel that, from a folder) into your personal plugin directory.

interactive.label: Uninstall
interactive.tooltip: Delete the selected plugin (asks first). Only plugins you installed yourself can be removed; built-in ones are switched off instead.

interactive.label: Move up
interactive.tooltip: Move the selected plugin earlier in the menus.

interactive.label: Move down
interactive.tooltip: Move the selected plugin later in the menus.

interactive.label: Rename…
interactive.tooltip: Change the name this plugin shows in the menus. Edits the plugin's manifest, which is the field the menus actually read.

interactive.label: Icon…
interactive.tooltip: Choose, generate or clear the icon shown beside this plugin.

interactive.label: Open folder
interactive.tooltip: Open the selected plugin's directory in the file browser.

interactive.label: Copy
interactive.tooltip: Copy the rows the table shows now, with the column headers, to the clipboard as tab-separated text.

interactive.label: Export CSV
interactive.tooltip: Write the rows and columns the table shows now to a CSV file.

interactive.label: Show disabled plugins
interactive.tooltip: Include switched-off plugins in the table. Off, they are hidden entirely.

interactive.label: Help
interactive.tooltip: Explain the table, the dependency columns and the switches.

interactive.label: Guide
interactive.tooltip: Walk through picking a plugin, switching it off and saving.

interactive.label: Disabled
interactive.tooltip: Switch this plugin off. If other plugins require it, you are told which before the change sticks.

interactive.label: Show in main toolbar
interactive.tooltip: Pin this plugin to the main window toolbar.
